_about: Limits enforced by `scripts/perf_check.py --check` (the perf job in .github/workflows/tests.yml). Sizes are bytes on the wire (gzip), times are milliseconds on a cold load with no CPU throttle on a GitHub-hosted runner (set 2026-10 from a measured 0.8 s LCP / 150 ms TBT on a laptop, about three times looser). Tighten them when the numbers fall; raise one only with a reason in the commit. 2026-10 (second set): raised 15 % over the measured numbers for the renter's three paintings, the office chair and the 25E layout of twelve shown pieces (about +25 draws, +20k triangles, and the painting textures: Fast draws them at most 1024 px, Visual up to 4096). Standalone file_bytes 27.0 -> 27.4 MB (2026-10): the file now keeps each photo's saved path (+0.15 MB) so its photos come from the published copy instead of the listing sites' links.

render._about: Limits enforced by `scripts/perf_check.py --render --check` (the 3D render budget step of the perf job), per device, view and quality config (fast-L0 ... visual-L5, the levels of dashboard/js/room3d/quality.js). draws and triangles are those of one frame including the shadow pass; texture_mb is an ESTIMATE of the scene's textures plus shadow maps (room3d/budget.js), not a GPU reading. Set 2026-10 from measured numbers on the Paramount Tower 25E example (Unit 3D Inside; the studio's eye view with the city), 15-20 % looser; counts do not depend on the GPU. The ladder itself is also checked: a lighter level must not cost more than the one above it. Tighten them when the numbers fall; raise one only with a reason in the commit. 2026-10 (second set): raised 15 % over the measured numbers for the renter's three paintings, the office chair and the 25E layout of twelve shown pieces (about +25 draws, +20k triangles, and the painting textures: Fast draws them at most 1024 px, Visual up to 4096).
